history.summary: A 99LH 2BR (The Clement Canopy, D05 Clementi/West Coast) at $1.42M / $2,000 psf — bang on the $1,996 URA median, with a solid, well-sampled 3.8% resale CAGR over 143 transactions. A reliable, liquid Clementi entry near One-North/NUS, but priced at fair value with no discount and modest appreciation.
history.rating_rationale: The standout here is data reliability: 143 URA txns underpinning a credible 3.8% resale-only CAGR, and the asking ($2,000 psf) sits essentially at the $1,996 median — fair, not cheap. D05 has genuine catalysts (One-North tech hub, NUS, Clementi amenities, TEL) and the $1.42M efficient 2BR is in the deep buyer band. But 99LH (2019), median pricing with no value cushion, and a middling 3.8% rate keep it Neutral rather than Buy — you are paying fair value for steady, not outsized, performance.
red_flags: Priced at URA median ($2,000 vs $1,996) — no value cushion
Modest 3.8% appreciation despite a prime sub-district
MRT proximity not listed in dossier
catalysts: Clementi amenities and Tengah/JLD spillover over the long run
